name: pivotkit-monorepo
description: Repository root of pivotkit: npm workspaces for pivotkit-core, pivotkit-react and pivotkit-element, the playground (examples/playground) and its browser tests (tests/browser).

scripts.types: npm run types --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:types --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pack:check: node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-core && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-react
